phases.objective: Phase-1 mutation-free classifier/planner foundation: make the shared environment convergence engine the canonical Staging drift classifier and plan authority, exact-bind repository and Gateway release identity, resolve execution targets server-side, keep operator acknowledgement non-executive, retire direct workflow dispatch from the AutoPilot convergence path, and keep Staging apply fail-closed until a server-governed adapter exists.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: An exact Staging release certifies ready from a canonical profile-resolved policy and profile-owned Gateway endpoint; only an explicitly marked synthetic loopback fixture may override the probe base. A healthy Gateway on an older exact SHA remains non-ready and is classified as governed convergence drift.
steps: Load the canonical environment-convergence registry and resolve the Staging Gateway policy server-side from its profile.
Validate policy key, public host and expected policy hash before constructing or probing the Gateway endpoint.
Reject caller-selected policy paths and reject Gateway URL overrides unless the override is an explicitly marked synthetic loopback fixture.
For a profile-valid reachable Gateway, keep gateway_health_reachable as integrity evidence but evaluate gateway_exact_commit as readiness/convergence evidence.
Classify a healthy old sourceCommit as convergence_drift/release_identity_mismatch with repairability=governed and automatic_apply_allowed=false.
Emit the classification in report.convergence while retaining certification as the final judge and requiring exact Gateway release identity for artifact_set.complete.
Keep all provider, database, migration, Production, ruleset and secret mutation disabled.
assertions: The Staging certification policy must match activation_gateway_staging, activation-dev.mad4b.com and the profile expected_policy_hash before any external Gateway probe.
The live certifier does not read STAGING_CERT_GATEWAY_POLICY_PATH or any other caller-selected policy path.
A Gateway base override is accepted only when STAGING_CERT_SYNTHETIC_LOOPBACK_FIXTURE is true and the resolved host is loopback; all other overrides fail closed before the Gateway probe.
gateway_environment_profile_current is an integrity failure and manual_non_repairable when false.
gateway_exact_commit is classified as convergence_drift/release_identity_mismatch rather than integrity corruption.
A healthy old Gateway SHA yields degraded certification when readiness is not required and convergence.status=reconciliation_required.
An exact Gateway SHA and policy hash remain required for artifact_set.complete and release-ready certification.
The convergence handoff never auto-applies and live certification performs no provider or Production mutation.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: AutoPilot consumes report.convergence.next_governed_handoff from the shared engine, produces a repository/policy/observed-state-bound immutable plan with a server-resolved execution target, and stops at operator acknowledgement/governed-authority boundaries without dispatching a workflow or mutating a provider.
steps: Run the local Staging core once and treat its certification state as observation evidence.
Pass observed blocking/degraded reasons to the shared environment convergence bridge rather than classify Gateway drift inside PowerShell.

Build an immutable convergence plan whose plan_sha256 binds the canonical repository, branch, exact commit, desired Gateway policy identity, observed Gateway policy identity and server-resolved execution target.
Resolve bundle and resource binding from the environment profile on the server; callers do not select an execution target.
Consume report.convergence.next_governed_handoff as the only convergence next-action source.
Treat operator_acknowledgement as a non-execution acknowledgement; retain approval_checkpoint only as a transitional compatibility alias.
Stop at approval_required when acknowledgement is missing and at governed_authority_required while Staging has no server-governed apply adapter.
Keep the legacy Converge-StagingActivationGateway helper as a non-mutating fail-closed compatibility tombstone.
Guard the launcher, legacy helper and shared bridge against direct provider commands and workflow dispatch.
assertions: The Staging profile has apply_capability=null and governed_apply_ready=false until a focused server-governed adapter exists.
Changing observed Gateway policy identity changes plan_sha256 even when repository, branch and commit remain unchanged.
The execution target is server_resolved=true, caller_target_override_allowed=false and Staging execution_ready=false.
operator_acknowledgement_is_execution_authority=false and approval_checkpoint is only a transitional alias.
Invoke-Staging-One-Click.ps1 contains no hardcoded Gateway drift-key allowlist and does not call Converge-StagingActivationGateway.ps1.
Converge-StagingActivationGateway.ps1 performs no GitHub workflow dispatch, provider mutation, trust installation, database mutation or Production mutation.
The orchestrator boundary includes the One-Click launcher, legacy helper and shared convergence bridge.
The legacy deployment workflow may remain as infrastructure but is not an execution primitive available to the AutoPilot boundary.
